sql: SELECT country, COUNT(customerNumber) FROM customers GROUP BY country

SELECT T1.productName FROM products T1 JOIN orderdetails T2 ON T1.productCode=T2.productCode WHERE T1.productScale='1:18' AND T1.productLine='Classic Cars' GROUP BY T1.productName ORDER BY SUM(T2.quantityOrdered) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(customerNumber) FROM customers WHERE creditLimit <= 100000 AND customerNumber IN (SELECT customerNumber FROM payments WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', paymentDate) = '2004')), T1.customerName FROM customers T1 JOIN payments T2 ON T1.customerNumber=T2.customerNumber WHERE T1.creditLimit<=100000 AND STRFTIME('%Y',T2.paymentDate)='2004' GROUP BY T1.customerNumber, T1.customerName ORDER BY SUM(T2.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.customerName, T2.contactFirstName, T2.contactLastName, SUM(T3.amount) FROM employees T1 JOIN customers T2 ON T2.salesRepEmployeeNumber=T1.employeeNumber JOIN payments T3 ON T2.customerNumber=T3.customerNumber JOIN offices T4 ON T1.officeCode=T4.officeCode WHERE T4.city='Tokyo' AND T1.reportsTo=1056 GROUP BY T2.customerName, T2.contactFirstName, T2.contactLastName ORDER BY SUM(T3.amount) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.orderNumber) FROM orderdetails T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T1.orderNumber=T2.orderNumber WHERE T1.quantityOrdered*T1.priceEach>4000 AND T2.status='Cancelled'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.orderNumber) FROM orderdetails T1 JOIN orders T2 ON T1.orderNumber=T2.orderNumber WHERE T1.quantityOrdered<30 AND STRFTIME('%Y',T2.orderDate)='2003'
SELECT COUNT(T1.orderNumber) FROM orderdetails T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.productCode=T2.productCode WHERE T2.MSRP-T2.buyPrice>100
SELECT DISTINCT T2.customerName FROM payments T1 JOIN customers T2 ON T1.customerNumber=T2.customerNumber WHERE T1.amount>50000
SELECT SUM(T1.amount) FROM payments T1 JOIN customers T2 ON T1.customerNumber=T2.customerNumber WHERE T2.country='USA'
SELECT SUM(T1.amount) FROM payments T1 JOIN customers T2 ON T1.customerNumber=T2.customerNumber WHERE T2.creditLimit=0 AND STRFTIME('%Y',T1.paymentDate)='2003'

SELECT COUNT(T2.country) FROM orders T1 JOIN customers T2 ON T1.customerNumber=T2.customerNumber WHERE T1.status='Cancelled' AND T2.country='France' GROUP BY T2.customerNumber HAVING COUNT(T1.status)=2
SELECT COUNT(T1.employeeNumber), T1.email FROM employees T1 JOIN offices T2 ON T1.officeCode=T2.officeCode WHERE T2.city='Sydney' AND T1.jobTitle LIKE '%Sales Manager%'
SELECT COUNT(customerNumber) FROM customers WHERE country='Australia' AND creditLimit<220000
SELECT customerNumber FROM payments ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.email, T1.employeeNumber FROM employees T1 JOIN offices T2 ON T1.officeCode=T2.officeCode WHERE T2.country='USA' AND T2.state='CA'
SELECT MAX(T1.quantityOrdered*T1.priceEach) - AVG(T1.priceEach) FROM orderdetails T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.productCode=T2.productCode WHERE T2.productLine='Planes'

SELECT T2.firstName, T2.lastName, T3.firstName, T3.lastName FROM customers T1 JOIN employees T2 ON T1.salesRepEmployeeNumber=T2.employeeNumber JOIN employees T3 ON T2.reportsTo=T3.employeeNumber JOIN payments T4 ON T1.customerNumber=T4.customerNumber ORDER BY T4.amount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.productName, T1.quantityOrdered*T1.priceEach FROM orderdetails T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.productCode=T2.productCode JOIN orders T3 ON T1.orderNumber=T3.orderNumber JOIN customers T4 ON T3.customerNumber=T4.customerNumber JOIN employees T5 ON T4.salesRepEmployeeNumber=T5.employeeNumber JOIN offices T6 ON T5.officeCode=T6.officeCode WHERE T6.city='Boston' AND T5.jobTitle='Sales Rep' ORDER BY T1.quantityOrdered*T1.priceEach DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(T1.priceEach-T2.buyPrice) FROM orderdetails T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.productCode=T2.productCode JOIN orders T3 ON T1.orderNumber=T3.orderNumber JOIN customers T4 ON T3.customerNumber=T4.customerNumber WHERE T4.country='USA' AND T3.orderDate BETWEEN '2003-01-06' AND '2005-05-09'
